title: Job
description: A job (ARC-23): work that needs a model, queued by the Core with an explicit contract, stored as YAML in `jobs/<id, six digits>.yaml` of the campaign workspace. Protocol version 0.1.0. The Core calls no model: a runner, or the GM's own agent host session, starts the job (ARC-24, ARC-29). An agent receives the contract (every field but `at`, `status` and `attempts`) and passes `job` to each delegated action it takes, which is then bound by the delegation table of the job's moment and logs the job's runner configuration.

id.description: Increasing, unique among the workspace's jobs.

at.description: Real time the job was queued.

playbook.description: The playbook (an Agent Skills skill name) the agent follows (ARC-21).

inputs.description: The inputs the playbook declares, by name. A file input is an absolute path; a Source is referenced, never copied (PKG-12).

expected_output.description: What the job must have produced, as the playbook states it.

responsibility.description: The responsibility the job works under, from the playbook.

moment.description: The moment the job was queued in; its delegation table binds the job's actions.

tier.description: How much model the job needs (ARC-25): the playbook's tier unless the job overrides it. Never a model name. A hint on a manual start (ARC-29).

campaign_language.description: The campaign language (BCP 47) the job generates content in (ARC-21).

vocabulary.description: The slice of the campaign vocabulary (CAN-22) relevant to the job: entity names and aliases.

entity.description: The acting entity the job works for (an NPC to voice, a creature to run), a canon entity id; null for work with no acting entity. An entity override of it withdraws the job while queued (DEL-16). Absent from jobs queued before entity overrides.

blocking.description: Whether the call the job prepares blocks the current turn or scene.

deadline.description: A live job's latency cap (ARC-28): the deadline of the call it prepares (DEL-30), set when it is queued in a live session. null outside a live session: no cap.

status.description: queued until an attempt starts it; queued again when that attempt fails (ARC-27); done when the agent finishes it or the runner's agent exits cleanly; missed when a live job's deadline passed first: its call's safe default applies, logged as a `safe_default` action log entry, and the job takes no further action; withdrawn when an entity override of its `entity` landed while it was queued, logged the same way and never started (DEL-16).

attempts.description: Every start attempt, in order, with the configuration used (ARC-27). No silent substitution: a configuration not in the list is never tried. When the list is exhausted the job stays queued and an exception is raised as a call on the GM, held for the break.

manual.description: Started by the GM from their own agent host session (ARC-29), the configuration as that session reports it; otherwise by a runner.

runner_configuration.description: One entry of the GM's runner configuration (ARC-26), from the machine configuration.

host.description: The agent host, a command template name (claude, codex, or one of the machine configuration's hosts).
